scope: Full screen group internal LCD actor commit/Apply/explicit reapply with prepared JPEG/media/composition and current sensor caches; fan+lighting runtime and group transport still pending

reference_rotation.conclusion: Nonzero H264 rotation remains an explicit parity gap; Windows rotates the final bitmap before encoding, so hardware rotation alone cannot be assumed equivalent.

contract.prepare: PreparedScreenGroup loads/pins images/fonts and media, renders first JPEG or composition AU before LCD mutation; source variants Idle/JPEG theme/media/composition. Source identity/config retained for reapply validation. Future transport must bound runtime job admission.
contract.serialize: CommitScreenGroup executes in sole LCD owner. Receipt/parameters/ticket and streaming firmware checked before owner commit. Durable receipt precedes joined old-source replacement, LCD config and first frame. Replace invalidates older renders/preparation. Apply emits no redundant settings deltas.
contract.repeat: Readback/repeat acknowledges current state without Apply. Unneeded prepared composition workers stop/join on repeat/rejection.
contract.failure: Config/frame failures return committed storage receipt with independent lcd.last_error. Unknown storage outcome stops source and blocks mutations until restart/recovery; read-only state remains available. No stale source settings are written over import.
contract.reapply: Prepare from current durable settings, including a fresh actor after restart. ReapplyScreenGroup checks kind/current contents, generation, ticket and exact active-source/config identity; no settings/profile revision mutation or replay of later deleted slots.
contract.teardown: Queued group composition workers stop/join. Shutdown checked after old-source stop and again after config acknowledgement; committed intent is deferred for replay without starting the first frame after observed shutdown.
contract.limits: JPEG respects brightness/rotation. Existing streaming path requires rotation0 and known firmware>=1.5; unsupported cases reject before group commit. Nonzero streaming rotation stays required/unimplemented.

coverage: JPEG config/frame after durable receipt; brightness73/rotation90 retained; sensor-only JPEG bytes change after live cache update.
Lost reply/repeat after Clear gives current state without writes; pre-import ticket cannot start a delayed second import.
Injected config and frame failures retain receipt; repeated import does not Apply again; explicit reapply retries without profile revision increment.
New brightness makes prepared old reapply stale; current state remains unchanged.
Managed media framing and actual FFmpeg procedural composition first AU apply with known firmware. No actual H264 hardware decode claimed.
Nonzero streaming rotation rejected during preparation, firmware1.4 rejected before storage/output writes; extra prepared composition reaped.
Queued composition import on shutdown joined without commit or writes.
Fresh actor/settings store can prepare/reapply receipt after restart without former runtime cache.
Broken journal halts mutations, retains read-only state and preserves journal without output writes.
Shutdown during held config acknowledgement retains committed receipt, emits no first frame and reports deferred replay.
Media group replaced by JPEG group joins old reader; no old video payload appears after the new JPEG frame.

regressions.scope: Existing lcd_keeper and screen_reset_actor tests passed before final workspace; also included in final full suite.
